title: DataCure Protocol
description:
DataCure Network introduces a revolutionary solution in the form of a blockchain-based unique health ID card. This ID card is represented by a Soulbound Token (SBT), which securely links to the patient's health data.
Benefits of the Health ID Card:

Enhanced Data Management: The health ID card simplifies the management and accessibility of medical records, providing a single, secure point of reference for a patient’s medical history.
Empowering Patients: Patients gain unprecedented control over their health data, including who can access it and for what purposes, enhancing trust and transparency.
Facilitating Seamless Care: With this unified health ID, healthcare providers can quickly and securely access a patient’s medical history, leading to more informed and efficient treatment.
